summary: Re-verify of the builder's fix-forward (43df0fa1). The one blocker (REV-P1 CSV formula injection) is properly closed: csvEscape now runs neutralizeFormula BEFORE RFC4180 quoting — a cell whose first char is = + - @ TAB or CR gets a leading apostrophe and is force-quoted. Probed adversarially against 14 vectors (HYPERLINK, DDE via ;, +cmd, @, leading tab/CR, leading space, nbsp, fullwidth-homoglyph =, already-apostrophe, second-line-of-multiline formula) — ALL held inert. REV-N1 (guard on filtered set) and UX-N1 (dead modifier) also correctly resolved. Verdict flips to approved.

reverify_attacks.note: still starts with =, caught by ^[=+\-@..] → neutralized
TAB is in the char class
CR is in the char class
not a spreadsheet formula vector to begin with — leading space defangs in Excel/LibreOffice; emitted literal, inert
first char is not an ASCII formula operator; no spreadsheet treats nbsp-leading as formula
not an ASCII operator; spreadsheets do not evaluate it as a formula, so nothing to neutralize
first char is ' not = → not re-prefixed; cell text is literal, inert

reverify_attacks.attack: formula on the SECOND line of a multiline cell (line1\n=danger)
reverify_attacks.note: cell does not START with a formula char → not evaluated; csvEscape quotes it correctly (newline inside quotes, one field — quoting NOT broken)

non_blocking.finding: A legitimate value that happens to start with + or - (phone '+79991234567', negative number '-5') is now apostrophe-prefixed. This is the STANDARD OWASP formula-injection tradeoff and is acceptable. It is honestly captured in the tests (csvEscape('-2+3') asserts "'-2+3"; csvEscape('+cmd|/c calc') asserts "'+cmd|/c calc") — the prefixing of +/- leading values is asserted in plain sight, not hidden. The grant-trail CSV has no phone/number column, so real-world false-positive impact here is essentially nil.

REV-N1 resolved: export guard is now rows.length===0 and export serialises rowsToCsv(rows) — the SAME filtered set. displayRows is read ONLY to pick the honest empty-state wording (нет записей vs нет совпадений фильтра), a correct secondary use, not the guard. Two distinct honest empty states.
